sam_sre: Seeing a short spike of apiserver 502/504s in asia-southeast1 starting ~5m ago. Likely tied to a large GPU onboarding wave.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] apiserver 5xx spike detected (asia-southeast1) - error rate x7.

sam_sre: apiserver log snippet:
```
E0601 03:07:11.101 apiserver.go:290] proxy error: dial tcp 10.20.30.4:6443: connect: connection reset by peer
E0601 03:07:11.122 apiserver.go:312] watch queue length: 2574
```

celine: infra metrics show NAT ephemeral ports at 99% and conntrack entries exploding on kube-proxies during the attach window.

omar: autoscaler kicked off ~200 preemptible GPU nodes at once in that region at 03:00. image pulls + kubelet heartbeats generate a lot of outbound sockets.

sam_sre: chain looks like: parallel attaches -> NAT/conntrack exhaustion -> apiserver proxy resets -> watch backlog growth -> etcd follower latency blips.

celine: immediate steps I'll run: (1) enable a second regional NAT and port-preserving SNAT, (2) temporarily throttle autoscaler attach concurrency.

omar: rolling a canary to set max_parallel_attach=6 and attach_backoff=25s now. deploy-bot will schedule.

deploy-bot: helm upgrade scheduled: gpu-autoscaler v3.4.0-canary at 04:00 UTC (staggered attach).

finance-bot: [INFO] Extra NAT gateway in asia-southeast1 estimated cost = $210/day.

sam_sre: followups: add alert for NAT ephemeral > 90% (1m), apiserver watch backlog > 1500 (2m), and etcd commit latency > 120ms (1m). INFRA ticket for NAT sizing and autoscaler tuning.

celine: INFRA-8207 created with conntrack dumps attached. will monitor the canary window and report back. :spiral_note_pad:
